text:
Priya: ACME pilot ask: guaranteed surge capacity for Premium, remove the existing softcap grace. need a quick plan.
Evan: strike me as an addon (reserve-capacity) so we don't rework all Premium SLAs.
Sam: +1 addon. key questions: billing model, rollback window, routing priority, and ops isolation.
Ravi: billing proposal: monthly reserved token bucket + overage per-token. proration on signup/termination.
Priya: rollback window? they want ability to drop reserve quickly during pilot. propose 10 days soft-exit.
Evan: 10d ok. ops: can we isolate a reserve pool? if not, we need a degrade path.
ops-bot: current autoscaler doesn't support an isolated reserve pool. ops ticket created: INF-5012 to add "reserve_pool" + hard-fallback -> best-effort lane.
Sam: launch checklist draft:
- PRD with config schema and priority tags
- Pricing snippet + pilot discount (20% for first 2 months?)
- Billing: reserved accounting, proration rules, exposure cap
- Ops playbook: pool exhaustion, alerts, mitigation
- Docs + sales FAQ + contract addendum for soft-exit
Ravi: finance note: ok to discount 20% if per-customer exposure capped at $30k.
Priya: decision: ship as addon "reserve_capacity", reserved+overage billing, 10d soft-exit, 20% pilot discount w/ $30k exposure cap.
Evan: I'll draft brief SOW language for sales and include negotiation bullets.
Sam: eng needs sample config to start work ->
```yaml
addon: reserve_capacity
reserved_tokens: 500000
priority_tag: reserve_priority
fallback: best_effort_cluster
```
Priya: next steps: Priya -> write PRD + pricing page. Evan -> sales comms. Ops -> estimate INF-5012. Legal to draft contract addendum.
ops-bot: INF-5012 assigned to ops-squad. ETA: initial estimate by Tue.
Priya: thanks all, please flag blockers. will need final signoff end of week. :thumbsup:
